steps.title: Thaw and expand NK‑92 cells
steps.instruction: Thaw NK‑92 cells (ATCC CRL‑247, RRID: CVCL_2147) and culture in a humidified incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; replace medium every 2–3 days, passage 2–3 times per week at a 1:2–1:3 split ratio, maintaining a seeding density of 2 × 10⁵–3 × 10⁵ cells mL⁻¹, and keep the culture for at least one week before starting the assay.

steps.title: Freeze NK‑92 cells for storage
steps.instruction: Prepare freezing medium of 50 % FBS, 40 % NK‑92 growth medium, and 10 % DMSO; resuspend cells at ≤5 × 10⁶ cells mL⁻¹, aliquot, and store in liquid‑nitrogen vapor phase.

steps.title: Deprive NK‑92 of IL‑2
steps.instruction: Remove IL‑2 from the culture medium and incubate the cells for at least 16 h before plating.

steps.title: Prepare drug dilution series
steps.instruction: Dilute each test drug in IL‑2‑free medium to a 5× concentration of the highest assay concentration (e.g., 150 nM); use this stock to generate the required serial dilutions (3‑, 5‑, or 10‑fold) for the assay.

steps.title: Plate NK‑92 cells
steps.instruction: Seed NK‑92 cells at 5 × 10⁴ cells per well in 80 µL IL‑2‑free medium in a 96‑well black assay plate, using triplicate wells and avoiding edge wells to minimize evaporation.

steps.title: Add drug to wells
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of the appropriate drug dilution to each well; include wells receiving 20 µL of drug‑free medium as negative controls.

steps.title: Harvest and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Count cells (minimum 4.8 × 10⁶ cells required for a full plate); centrifuge the plate at 1 600 rpm for 5 min and discard supernatant; resuspend cells in IL‑2‑free medium; repeat centrifugation at 1 600 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant; finally resuspend cells at 7.5 × 10⁵ cells mL⁻¹ in IL‑2‑free medium and incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Add resazurin and incubate
steps.instruction: After 24 h, add 10 µL resazurin (R&D Systems Catalog #AR002) to each well, mix, and incubate for 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Perform sequential fluorescence readings
steps.instruction: Return the plate to the incubator, wait 1 h, then repeat the resazurin addition and incubation (Step 8); repeat this cycle to obtain four fluorescence readings (typically at 0, 1, 2, 3 h) and select the most stable time point (usually the 3 h reading) for analysis.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence
steps.instruction: Ensure no air bubbles are present; read fluorescence on a Tecan plate reader using excitation/emission 530–570 nm with a reference correction at 590–620 nm.

steps.title: Analyze data in GraphPad Prism
steps.instruction: Export the adjusted fluorescence values, log‑transform the data, and fit a non‑linear regression using “log(agonist) vs. normalized response – Variable slope – Least squares fit” in GraphPad Prism 8.0 to determine the EC₅₀.
